title: Lusail, Doha — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Lusail, Doha: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Lusail is a city in Doha with a population of 50,000. Qatar’s planned smart city north of Doha, built for the 2022 World Cup and designed as a sustainable urban center. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 330 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
